spans.s:
चल् चल् [cf. चट् and चर्], cl. 1. P.
(sometimes A.) चलति, -ते, चचाल, च-
लिष्यति, अचालीत्, चलितुम्, to move one's self, be
moved; to stir, tremble, shake, quiver, throb, palpi-
tate, be agitated; totter; to move on or forward,
proceed, go away; to start off, set out, depart; to
walk, march; to be moved from one's usual course,
to be disturbed, become confused or disordered; to
go astray; to turn away from the right course, swerve,
deviate from (with abl., e. g. चलति धर्मात्, he
swerves from virtue); fall off, leave off (with abl.);
to sport about, frolic, play, wanton: Caus. P. चल-
यति or चालयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to cause to move, to
move, shake, jog, nudge, push, agitate, disturb; to turn
off from, to cause to deviate, lead away from; cause to
fall; drive away, remove or expel from; to cherish,
foster, (wrong form for बल्): Pass. of Caus. चाल्यते,
to be moved: Desid. चिचलिषति: Intens. चञल्यते
or चाचल्यते, चाचल्ति; [cf. Gr. κέλω, κέλλω, ὀ-
κέλλω, κέλης; Lat. celer, pro-cello, ex-cello, prœ-
cello; calco, calc-s, calcar; Hib. caill, ‘a path;’
Germ. falle; Gr. πάλλω, πέλω; Lat. pello.]

चल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, trembling, tremulous,
movable, shaking, loose, unfixed, unsteady, fickle,
fluctuating, perishable, disturbed, confused; (अस्), m.
agitation, shaking, trembling; wind; quicksilver;
(आ), f. lightning; incense; fortune or Lakṣmī the
goddess of fortune; N. of a metre consisting of four
lines of eighteen syllables each; [cf. अ-चल, निश्-
चल, चाल.]
—चल-कर्ण, अस्, m. the true distance
of a planet from the earth.
—चल-कृति, इस्, इस्, इ,
unsteady, wanton.
—चल-केतु, उस्, m. (in astron.)
N. of a moving Ketu.
—चल-चञ्चु, उस्, m., N. of
the Greek partridge, Perdix Rufa; [cf. चकोर.]
—चल-चित्त, अस्, आ, अम्, fickle-minded, inconstant;
(अम्), n. fickleness, mutability.
—चलचित्त-ता, f. or
चलचित्त-त्व, अम्, n. fickleness of mind, unsteadi-
ness, inconstancy, mutability, frivolity.
—चल-ता, f.
or चल-त्र, अम्, n. shaking, trembling, a tremulous
motion, pulsation.
—चल-दन्त, अस्, m. a loose
tooth.
—चल-दल, अस्, m. the holy fig-tree, Ficus
Religiosa; [cf. अश्वत्थ.]
—चल-पत्त्र, अस्, m.
the Ficus Religiosa; [cf. अश्वत्थ.]
—चल-सन्धि,
इस्, m. movable articulation of the bones, Diarthrosis.
 — 1. चलाचल (˚ल-अच्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, movable and
immovable, locomotive and stationary.
—चलातङ्क
(˚ल+आत्˚), अस्, m. rheumatism.
—चलात्मन् (˚ल-
आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, fickle-minded, inconstant.
—चलेन्द्रिय
(˚ल-इन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having unsteady organs, sensi-
tive, sensual, not having subdued senses or passions.
—चलेषु (˚ल-इषु), उस्, उस्, उ, one whose arrow
wavers or flies unsteadily.

चाल चाल, अस्, m. (fr. rt. चल्), the thatch
or roof of a house; the blue jay; shaking, the being
movable.

चलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, going, moving.
—चलत्-पदम्.
ind. moving, walking.
—चलत्-पूर्णिमा, f. a small
fish called Chanda, = चन्द्र-चञ्चल.
—चलद्-
अङ्ग or चलद्-अङ्गक, अस्, m. a fish, a sort of gilt-
head, commonly Ceṅgā, Ophiocephalus Aurantiacus.

चलन, अस्, आ, अम्, moving, movable, trembling
tremulous, shaking; (अस्), m. a foot; a deer, an
antelope; (ई), f. a short petticoat worn by common
women; the rope for tying an elephant; (अम्), n. a
shaking motion, shaking, trembling; walking about,
wandering, roaming; turning off from, leaving off.

चालन, अम्, n. causing to move or go, causing to
pass through a sieve, sifting, shaking, moving to
and fro, wagging (as the tail), loosening; muscular
action; (ई), f. a sieve, a strainer.

चलनक, अस् or अम्, m. or n. a short petticoat
worn by women of low rank; (इका), f. silken fringes.

चलनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be moved or shaken,
movable.

चालनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be moved, capable of
being moved.

चलमान, अस्, आ, अम्, going, moving, proceeding,
shaking, &c.
चलस्, अस्, n. wood-sorrel.

2. चलाचल, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. चल् with reduplica-
tion), moving to and fro, movable, tremulous, unfixed,
unsteady, shaking, loose; variable; (अस्), m. a cow.

चलित, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, departed, proceeded (often
used like a past tense, e. g. स चलितः, he started off,
he departed); shaking, trembling.

चलितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone away; to be
moved, movable.

चलु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. चल्), water hastily
taken up in the hollowed palm of the hand for rincing
the mouth &c.; a handful or mouthful of water; [cf.
गण्डूष.]

चलुक, अस्, m. = the preceding; also a small pot,
a gallipot, &c.; N. of a man; [cf. चुलुक.]

चलद्विष चलद्विष, अस्, m. the Kokila or
Indian cuckoo.

चलि चलि, इस्, m. a cover, a wrapper, a
surtout; [cf. चोल.]
चालक, अस्, m. a restive elephant.

चाल्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be moved; to be loosened
or shaken or led away from.
चालिक्य चालिक्य, अस्, m. a patronymic.
